inputs.text: [serious] Picture the Earth: it's very cold, very dark, very empty. [pauses] The big dinosaurs, the giants, they needed A LOT, A LOT of plants. [softly] But plants stop growing in the dark and the cold. Nothing left to eat for the giants. [pauses] So the big dinosaurs, slowly… fade away.
[softly] Oh… they don't come back after?
[softly] Yes, [confident] they fade away. [pauses] But listen closely — because what happens next is BEAUTIFUL.
